title: Vapor Deluxe Daddy Silicone Tubing
description:
The Vapor Deluxe Daddy Silicone Tubing is an essential accessory for vaping enthusiasts. Designed for the Daddy Deluxe Vaporizer, this high-quality silicone tubing ensures a smooth and consistent vaping experience.

Measuring as a generous 10-foot piece, it’s perfect for those who prefer a longer hose. Made to withstand high temperatures, this high temp hose can handle up to 500°F, ensuring durability and longevity. Its precise i.d and o.d measurements ensure a perfect fit for your vaporizer. Whether you’re replacing an old tube or upgrading, the Deluxe Daddy silicone tubing is the top choice for premium performance. Don’t miss out on this deluxe experience!
